name: yonatan-times
description: The Yonatan Times — newspaper portfolio with admin CMS, deployed as one Railway service

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix web install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --include=dev && npm --prefix web run build:only && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy && if [ "$RUN_SEED" = "true" ] || [ "$RUN_SEED" = "1" ]; then npx prisma db seed; fi && node dist/index.js
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
